title: 修復既有 Job owner 讀取遺漏呼叫者與租戶上下文

observed_failure.read_error_message: Job source owners unreachable or returned invalid payloads: training-session (http://training-session:8096/api/training/preview-jobs/c9e1de9ce09f4c46)

root_cause.explanation: services/control-plane/bff/ports/job_read.py::_default_http_get previously constructed a bare urllib.request.Request with only Accept: application/json and did not read the request-scoped caller context populated by OwnerReadContextMiddleware (authorization / selected_tenant) or forward Authorization, X-Tenant-Id, and X-Pantheon-Service via command_adapters.base.http_request_json_with_headers. Upstream owner services such as training-session enforce inbound_authority checks requiring X-Tenant-Id, X-Pantheon-Service: control-plane-bff, and caller Authorization on /api/training/preview-jobs and /api/training/preview-jobs/{job_id}, returning HTTP 400 (TENANT_REQUIRED) to bare requests and causing BFF job reads to fail with HTTP 503 (DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE).

summary: Reused core.owner_reads (authorization, selected_tenant) and command_adapters.base (bound_tenant, http_request_json_with_headers, ActionUnavailableError) inside JobReadPort._default_http_get.

Deleted the duplicate bare Accept-only urllib.request.Request construction in _default_http_get while preserving the 6-source _JOB_SOURCES catalog, HttpGetFn callback contract, and single JobReadPort reader.

Propagated ActionUnavailableError from bound_tenant so cross-tenant reads fail closed with HTTP 403 TENANT_MISMATCH before any upstream network I/O, while preserving (True, None) on HTTP 404 and (False, None) on non-404 HTTPError/URLError/TimeoutError.

Added synthetic local HTTP owner contract tests in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_jobs_source_owner_contract.py covering list_jobs_bff, get_job_bff, and get_job_logs_bff header forwarding, sequential/concurrent statelessness, 401/403 zero-IO fail-closed behavior, and 404/503 status preservation.

ac1_single_owner_read_header_source.details: _default_http_get in services/control-plane/bff/ports/job_read.py reads authorization.get() and selected_tenant.get(), verifies tenant binding via bound_tenant({}, tenant_id=selected_tenant.get(), auth_token=caller_token), and delegates transport to http_request_json_with_headers.

ac2_job_read_regression_and_tenant_bound.details: Verified via TestDefaultHttpGetOwnerReadContext in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_jobs_source_owner_contract.py that /bff/jobs, /bff/jobs/{job_id}, and /bff/jobs/{job_id}/logs forward Authorization, X-Tenant-Id, and X-Pantheon-Service, remain isolated across sequential and concurrent callers, reject missing/invalid auth (401) and foreign tenant (403 TENANT_MISMATCH) with zero owner HTTP requests, and preserve 404 and 503 responses.

ac3_scope_and_line_budget.details: Only the 3 declared artifact paths are modified; net production diff in services/control-plane/bff/ports/job_read.py is +21 lines (<= 80 lines); no hosted/VM/SSH/provider calls were executed.
